Authors: Kitchin, John Carnegie Mellon University

Track: Reproducible Science

We will discuss the use of emacs + org-mode + python in enabling reproducible research. This combination of software enables researchers to intertwine narrative and mathematical text with figures and code that is executable within a document, with capture of the output. I remember seeing a great video a few years back on using python in org mode to make a research notebook. It really made me want to try org mode for literate / notebook style programming. cites.x: The Orgmode extension to Emacs has quite an elegant, flexible, and powerful way of doing what you want.

If you use emacs org-mode, check out org-drill [link] . It uses the same algorithms, allows you to tweak everything, and you can keep your flashcards alongside the relevant notes/code/files/issues/ToD…
